subject: FY25 School Budget Request
overview: The Medford School Committee approved a level-service FY25 budget request of $79,399,774 to transmit to the Mayor and City Council following extensive public comment opposing proposed cuts to staff and arts programming. The committee also received high school survey and CTE updates and endorsed co-locating Curtis-Tufts School with the high school.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including bills and payroll, a $3,000 Massachusetts Cultural Council grant, and meeting minutes as amended to protect student privacy and add a recording link.

items.title: Subcommittee Report: Ad Hoc Handbook Process
items.summary: Approved on first reading a three-phase timeline and policy for annual school handbook updates and approvals.

items.title: Subcommittee Report: Behavioral Health and Special Education
items.summary: Approved the subcommittee recommendation to co-locate Curtis-Tufts School with Medford High School as part of the future high school building project.

items.title: Superintendent Updates, CCSR, and Humanities Student Recognitions
items.summary: The superintendent clarified arts staffing concerns, followed by presentations honoring Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility participants and students achieving recognition in humanities, writing, and academic competitions.

items.title: Medford High School Update and Culture Survey
items.summary: Principal Cabral presented improving culture and climate survey results, and the committee approved a motion directing that high school administration receive necessary staffing to pilot an alternative education program for at-risk students next year.

items.title: Career Technical Education Update
items.summary: Voted to request that the school building committee and MSBA explore proposed CTE program expansions and new program offerings as part of the feasibility study.

items.title: FY25 School Budget Update and Request
items.summary: Following extensive public comment and a student petition protesting proposed staff, nursing, administrative, and arts coordinator cuts, the committee approved a level-service FY25 budget request of $79,399,774 to submit to the Mayor and City Council.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Read condolences for family members of district staff and observed a moment of silence.
